shortBio:
Armenian coloratura soprano Anna Avdalyan has been a permanent member of the music theatre ensemble at the Schleswig-Holsteinisches Landestheater in Germany since 2023. Her repertoire spans opera, operetta and musical theatre, combining vocal agility with expressive stage presence.

Born in Yerevan, Armenia, she has performed on stage since the age of six. After studying singing, piano and dance at music school, she continued her musical education at the Komitas State Conservatory in Yerevan before pursuing vocal studies at the State University of Music and Performing Arts Stuttgart, where she completed her Bachelor’s and Master’s degrees in opera in 2022 under Professor Ulrike Sonntag.

Her performed roles include the Queen of the Night in Mozart’s Die Zauberflöte, Susanna in Le nozze di Figaro, Sister Constance in Poulenc’s Dialogues des Carmélites and Mabel in Gilbert and Sullivan’s The Pirates of Penzance. Her artistic journey also includes international concert appearances and experience in musical theatre.
shortBioDe:
[Platzhalter] Die Sopranistin Anna Avdalyan wird für die leuchtende Wärme ihrer Stimme und die dramatische Wahrhaftigkeit ihrer Rollengestaltung gerühmt. Ihr Repertoire reicht von Mozart- und Puccini-Heldinnen bis zu den großen Partien Verdis, darunter Violetta, Mimì und die Gräfin Almaviva. Sie ist regelmäßig auf Opernbühnen und im Konzert in ganz Europa zu erleben.

In der kommenden Saison erarbeitet sie die Titelpartie in Dvořáks Rusalka.
